g.text: Bars show file or study spans, not continuous coverage. HOPmeter device files end by 18 Jan 2024; none overlap the Jan 2025 event.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647684

g.text: Both PowerWatch sensors returned in May–June 2022 and January–February 2025. October 2026 returns one; full paired history remains unverified.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #647684

g.text: The DRC2 survey is later than the event. Generator hours, voltage, device power, delivered oxygen and clinical outcomes remain distinct evidence layers.
